inputs.label: Bomberman Hero ROM (North America v1.0)
inputs.help: Your own Bomberman Hero (USA) v1.0 N64 ROM.

steps.text: Open Bomberman Hero from Library > Unknown Sources. When it asks for the ROM, select your copy in the Download folder.

notes: The guide only shows a .z64 file; other N64 ROM formats may also work. The only release has the tag n64, not a version.
